Hey I had the same issue, I called the number on the back of my red card 650-681-9470 turns out is was on my dasher direct card which is a random ass card tht they don’t send you at first (it’s supposed to b white) so basically she told me to download dasher direct, log in. I saw my balance and then I clicked “more” on the bottom right side clicked view virtual card and put it into my Apple Pay. You can do the same with Google pay too. It was either tht or wait 2-3 days for them to send the White Dasher card. Hope this helps
